decision.reasoning_trace: The search results were heavily cluttered with cases and accessories, but several high-quality speakers were available. I narrowed my consideration set to the JBL Charge 5 (the category leader), the Altec Lansing Soundbucket XL (for its ruggedness and Qi charging), the JBL Go 3 (for ultra-portability), the Audio Pro Addon C10 (as a high-end stationary option), and the JBL Flip 5 (as a budget-friendly renewed option). I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because it has an exceptional rating (4.8) and a massive review count (over 16,000), indicating long-term reliability and performance that justifies its $149 price tag.
